newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cen bank sets o/n repo at minimum 18.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cen bank sets o/n repo at minimum 18.10 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) set an overnight repo tender on Thursday to add liquidity to the market at the minimum rate of 18.10 percent.
The average rate in a similar tender on Wednesday reached 18.36 percent, while the minimum rate was set at 18.25 percent.
The CNB said it would accept maximum two bids from each interested party at the minimum of 100 million crowns before the deadline at 10:30 a.m. (0830 GMT).
